pcs.pc_description: ensure that visual inspections of the body components for cracks are performed
check the inflation pressure of the tyres as per the prescribed norms/ the requirement of the ground
examine the machine for loose or missing nuts and bolts, loose guards, connectors and pivot pins
check conditions of parking brake, main horn, reverse horn and head light
ensure footplates, grab irons, hand holds and steps are clean and free from mud, dirt and oil to reduce skidding risks
inspect electrical and hydraulic lines, as well as hoses for damage and leaks
check that the engine transmission oil, radiator coolant and battery electrolyte levels are all at the proper levels
drain water and sediment from the fuel tank if required
check that all protection and safety devices such as controls locking lever, loading arm locking pin and operator post rotation locking pin are in the right position as per the equipment manual
visual inspection to check the different controls, gauges, warning lights and other safety devices
inspect bucket pins and keepers for damage and connections for leaks
inspect and if necessary adjust the seat height, tilt and distance from the pedals
if a fault is found that is outside of the scope of the position, notify the supervisor immediately
keep inspection/maintenance logbook to keep track of all actions

modules.module_title: Starting and driving the Skid steer loader

pcs.pc_description: ensure the joystick controls are in neutral position before starting the skid steer loader
enter the cabin of the skid steer loader only with the engine turned off, lift arms down, attachments on the ground and stairs and grip bars in place
wear seat belt and adjust seat position as per ones comfort and safety
lower the safety/restraining bar
start the engine with the starting key and test all controls, including steering, forward and backward, raising and lowering lift arms and all other functions
start the machine by unlocking the controls using toggle switch near the instrument panel
steer the loader by moving the left and right arm controls together
check that skid steer loader load, operating speed and direction of machine are within limits
lift and lower the bucket through foot control and pedals as per the loading/unloading requirement
operate all the attachments in a skid steer loader as per the requirement and the operational manual
drive forward to engage and collect load
stop the machine just before you touch the material pile and drop the bucket to the ground with the front edge level
drive forward, pushing the bucket into the load until the tyre spin, then press the left pedal down with heel while still attempting to drive forward
push the right pedal with your heel to tilt the bucket back for driving, then back up and elevate the bucket to a safe carrying height
drive to the spot, press the right pedal with toe to tilt the bucket down and dump the load
ensure completion of work within defined time
determine and maintain a safe distance from other vehicles
when parked, make sure the skid steer loader is in a stationary position with the arms drawn and the controls turned off
set the parking brake and controls to relieve hydraulic pressure
ensure the engine is turned off as per the manufacturer's instructions
ensure the controls are locked and the ignition key is removed
unbuckle the safety belt, raise the safety bar and exit as per the manufacturer's instruction
ensure the tyres are in static position to avoid the vehicle moving forward or backward
report to the supervisor of any problems while operating the skid steer loader

check if all plates are attached into the vehicle
keep the footplates and steps clear of mud, grime, snow, dirt and oil and regularly clean air filter dust bowls

make certain that no engine maintenance is conducted while the engine is running or remains hot

diagnose the problem and identify appropriate repair procedures

dispose waste as per the guidelines of the site/ organisation
